interaction_history.overview: A magazine writer poses as a Jew to expose anti-Semitism.
interaction_history.title: Gentleman's Agreement

interaction_history.overview: After their production "Princess Ida" meets with less-than-stunning reviews, the relationship between Gilbert and Sullivan is strained to breaking. Their friends and associates attempt to get the two to work together again, which opens the way to "The Mikado," one of the duo's greatest successes.
interaction_history.title: Topsy-Turvy

interaction_history.overview: Recently released from a mental hospital, Ricky ties up Marina, a film star he once had sex with and keeps her hostage.
interaction_history.title: Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down!

interaction_history.overview: A zany heiress tries to help a tramp by making him the family butler.
interaction_history.title: My Man Godfrey

interaction_history.overview: On behalf of "oppressed bugs everywhere," an inventive ant named Flik hires a troupe of warrior bugs to defend his bustling colony from a horde of freeloading grasshoppers led by the evil-minded Hopper.
interaction_history.title: Bug's Life, A

interaction_history.overview: After an encounter with UFOs, a line worker feels undeniably drawn to an isolated area in the wilderness where something spectacular is about to happen.
interaction_history.title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind

interaction_history.overview: Overwhelmed by her suffocating schedule, touring European princess Ann takes off for a night while in Rome. When a sedative she took from her doctor kicks in, however, she falls asleep on a park bench and is found by an American reporter, Joe Bradley, who takes her back to his apartment for safety. At work the next morning, Joe finds out Ann's regal identity and bets his editor he can get exclusive interview with her, but romance soon gets in the way.
interaction_history.title: Roman Holiday

interaction_history.overview: From Spike Lee comes this vibrant semi-autobiographical portrait of a school-teacher, her stubborn jazz-musician husband and their five kids living in '70s Brooklyn.
interaction_history.title: Crooklyn

interaction_history.overview: Joan Wilder is thrust back into a world of murder, chases, foreign intrigue... and love. This time out she's duped by a duplicitous Arab dignitary who brings her to the Middle East, ostensibly to write a book about his life. Of course he's up to no good, and Joan is just another pawn in his wicked game. But Jack Colton and his sidekick Ralph show up to help our intrepid heroine save the day.
interaction_history.title: Jewel of the Nile, The

interaction_history.overview: When record store owner Rob Gordon gets dumped by his girlfriend, Laura, because he hasn't changed since they met, he revisits his top five breakups of all time in an attempt to figure out what went wrong. As Rob seeks out his former lovers to find out why they left, he keeps up his efforts to win Laura back.
interaction_history.title: High Fidelity
